reports.title: Infleqtion Reports Third Quarter 2026 Record Revenue Results, Achieves 30-Logical-Qubit Milestone and Maintains Full-Year Revenue Guidance

lines: (NYSE: INFQ) ("Infleqtion" or the "Company"), a global leader in quantum computing and quantum sensing powered by neutral atom technology, today reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $9.1 million, up 25% year over year, and maintained its 2026 revenue outlook of at least $45.1 million.

desk.headline: Revenue up 25% to $9.1m, below estimates; gross loss as costs jump; 2026 revenue outlook of at least $45.1m kept
results: Revenue rose 25% to $9.1m, short of the roughly $11.0m analysts expected; nine-month revenue was up 57% to $32.6m.
Cost of revenue nearly tripled to $10.3m, so the quarter swung to a $1.1m gross loss from a $3.7m gross profit.
Operating loss widened to $34.5m ($22.7m before stock pay and deal costs); the $19.7m net loss was cushioned by a $9.7m gain on an investment and $5.3m of interest income.
Cash and securities of $560m with no debt, but that includes a temporary $28m boost from payroll taxes still to be paid over.
Hit its target of 30 logical qubits for 2026 and won a $20m NASA contract expansion and a $12m award for a radio-direction sensor.

guidance.summary: Infleqtion kept its 2026 revenue outlook of at least $45.1m, last raised in the run-up to Q3 from $43.0m. With $32.6m booked in nine months, that implies at least $12.5m in Q4.

watch: Whether Q4 delivers the at least $12.5m needed to reach the full-year outlook.
Gross margin: whether costs settle after this quarter's gross loss.
Progress on the 2027 outlook the CEO flagged, as computing becomes a larger part of sales.
